Gain 1 random Artifact. When you drop below 35 Health, gain 1 more random Artifact, 1 random completed item, and 2 random component.

Remix Rumble Championship, 2023

3.name: Golden Gamble
3.description: Gain 2 gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain 2 Completed Item anvils.

3.name: Hold the Line
3.description: Champions in your back 2 rows gain 9% Ability Power and 8% Attack Damage for each champion that starts combat in your front row.

3.name: Level Up!
3.description: When you buy XP, gain an additional 2. Gain 6 immediately.

3.name: Living Forge
3.description: Gain an Artifact Anvil now and after every 9 player combats.

3.name: Lucky Gloves+
3.description: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain 2 Sparring Gloves now, then another after 4 player combats.

3.name: Luxury Subscription
3.description:
Gain a package containing a 5-cost champion, a 2-star 1-cost champion, and 3 gold.

At the start of the next 2 stages, gain the package again.

3.name: Master of All Origins
3.description:
Open an armory and choose one of  3 traits. Gain a Lux with that trait and a Spear of Shojin.

Traits on your board are more likely to appear in the armory. Lux provides +2 to her chosen trait

3.name: Money Monsoon
3.description: Gain 7 gold now and every round for the rest of the game.

3.name: Radiant Rascal
3.description: Gain a Radiant Thief's Gloves item. This equips 2 random Radiant items every round.

3.name: Shimmerscale Essence
3.description: Gain a Mogul's Mail. After 7  player combats, gain a Gamblers Blade.

3.name: Shopping Spree
3.description: When you level up, gain a number of free shop refreshes equal to your level +1. Gain 6 gold.

3.name: Tactician's Kitchen
3.description: Gain a random Emblem. After 3 rounds, gain a Tactician's Cape.

3.name: The Golden Egg
3.description: Gain a golden egg that hatches in 11 turns for a huge amount of loot. Winning player combat speeds up the hatch timer by an extra turn.

3.name: The Trait Tree+
3.description: Gain 3 random Emblems, a Reforger, and 4 gold.

3.name: Upward Mobility
3.description: Buying XP costs 1 less. Gain 2 Health and 1 free reroll whenever you level up.

3.name: Urf's Grab Bag
3.description: Gain 1 Spatula, 3 random components, and 5 gold.

3.name: We Stick Together
3.description:
Gain a random Emblem and a completed item anvil. Allies that share a trait with that Emblem gain 30% Attack Speed. 0 0

Into The Arcane Tactician's Crown, 2025

3.name: Birthday Present
3.description: Gain a 2-star champion and 1 gold each time you level up. The champion's cost tier is your level minus 4 (max: 5-cost).

3.name: Cursed Crown
3.description: Gain +2 max team size and your team gains 4% Durability, but you take double player damage when you lose a player combat.

3.name: Investment Strategy II
3.description: Your champions gain 8 permanent max health per interest you earn. Your max interest is increased by 2. Gain 8 gold now.

3.name: Trait Ladder
3.description: Gain a random emblem. After fielding 2 non-unique traits in a player combat, gain a reward. Then increase the number of traits needed and the size of the reward.
